name: Victor Mordenheim

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A lean, pale man who looks to be in his thirties, with prematurely grey hair, tired blue eyes and a faint scar on his forehead. He wears plain brown wool or a surgical gown.

sections.title: What brought him here
lines: Victor raised Adam as a son and tried to teach him to live among people. Adam attacked Elise von Brandthofen, vanished with Eva, and left Victor to save what remained of his wife.

sections.title: What he wants
lines: Victor wants a new body for Elise von Brandthofen. He will rob graves and comb hospices for suitable remains. Locals blame him for disappearances that Adam causes.

sections.title: Running Victor
lines: He rarely starts a fight and has no weapon training. He can make one attack with whatever weapon he has. Its damage depends on the weapon.

sections.title: Shared curse
lines: Victor cannot die while Adam lives. He shares Adam’s hit point total and can regrow from a surviving piece of his body.
Adam feels pain inflicted on Victor. If Victor’s body is completely destroyed, his spirit seeks a recently dead human man. The body takes on Victor’s appearance within a week.

description: Victor Mordenheim is the Lamordian surgeon who built Adam. He works in Schloss Mordenheim, where his machines keep his injured wife Elise von Brandthofen alive.

name: Adam

sections.title: Shared curse
lines: Adam feels wounds inflicted on Victor Mordenheim. He hates his creator and cannot bring himself to harm him.

sections.title: Combat
lines: Mundane weapons do not hurt him. A weapon needs a +1 or better enchantment to hit.
Natural cold and electricity cannot harm him. Their magical equivalents deal half damage. Nondamaging spells restore 1 hit point per spell level when absorbed.
He has an 80% chance to hide in shadows, move silently, detect noise or climb walls. His speed halves while moving silently. He can feign being affected by a spell to escape or set up an ambush.

sections.title: Closing the borders
lines: Adam can raise a blizzard to force anyone trying to leave Lamordia back into the domain.

description: Adam is a flesh golem built by Victor Mordenheim and the darklord of Lamordia. He keeps to the Isle of Agony and longs to be human.

name: Elise von Brandthofen

sections.title: At the table
lines: When she briefly regained consciousness, she asked for Eva and begged Victor to end her suffering. Her fate gives the party a reason to investigate the laboratory.

description: Victor Mordenheim’s wife and a fellow student of chemistry. Since Adam’s attack, she has survived through Victor’s machinery.

name: Eva
description: An orphan taken in by Victor Mordenheim and Elise von Brandthofen. Adam disappeared with her after the attack in the manor.

name: Lamordia

sections.title: Encounters
lines: Wolves and bears favor the highlands. Escaped flesh golems are a danger around Schloss Mordenheim.

description: A cold Ravenloft domain where science and craft command more respect than magic. Adam is its darklord, while Baron von Aubrecker governs its towns.

name: Schloss Mordenheim

sections.title: At the table
lines: The estate is falling into disrepair. Locals give it a wide berth, and small caves puncture the cliffs below it.

description: Victor Mordenheim’s family estate and laboratory. It overlooks the sea from a cliff north of Ludendorf.

name: Isle of Agony
description: An island in Lamordia where Adam usually retreats to a cave.
